title: botai assessment
description: A multidimensional assessment of one learning objective: Bloom's taxonomy levels plus a SOLO structural level. Every score carries evidence — a `bloom_score` with no evidence string is refused, the same rule the progress record applies to a mastery claim. This is formative: it informs what to teach next and is never itself a course grade.

assessment_id.description: Slug, not UUID: an assessment id is a readable, human-checkable handle (e.g. `intro-regression-check-01`) referenced in progress notes, and a slug keeps those references legible.

learning_objective.description: The objective this assessment measures, a slug matching `objective_id` in the track.

bloom_levels.description: Six Bloom levels. remembering/understanding/applying are required — an assessment that measures no level at all is not an assessment; the higher three are optional because many objectives stop at applying.

solo_level.description: SOLO structural outcome: from no relevant idea (prestructural) through isolated ideas to integrated understanding (relational, extended_abstract).

confidence.description: How confident the assessment itself is in these scores. Low confidence means the evidence was thin — not that the learner did badly.

evidence.description: What was actually demonstrated, in Russian, that justifies this score. A score with no evidence is a guess; requiring the string keeps every claim answerable.

bloom_score.description: One Bloom level: a 0..1 score plus the evidence behind it. Evidence is mandatory — this is the same rule as a mastery claim in the progress record.
